name: Thematic_Interleaving
description: We completely rewrite the domain into a spaceship power allocation scenario to prevent direct memorization. To defeat models that rely on crude text skimming, we mention the second phase (System Initialization) before the first phase (Capacitor Charge) in the opening narrative, while keeping their chronological order and input format strictly defined. A model skimming for keywords might bind $p_1$ to the first-mentioned phase, causing it to swap the LOAD outputs, whereas a model that genuinely reasons about the explicit Input definitions will correctly bind $p_1$ to the first chronological phase and output the correct certificate.
